observations: route_check --profile r10 on a0ec075e: exit 0, 0 failing, 0 allowlisted, 5 unrecorded noncritical leftovers (BAT_OVLO short segment, BUZZ_DRV / BAT_FAULT_N / I2C1_SDA tiny jogs, USB_ILIM detour), 28 bump windows; right_angle 0.

Against 92c3ad59 under the same checker the instance list differs only by the two J440 critical_via_no_gnd 'pad' instances (gone), the USB_LIMITED In2 extra_bends anchor (same seglens, reversed) and the PYRO1_CONT_MID u_turn (16.87,60.13) 10.288 mm -> (16.87,59.48) 10.575 mm.
Independent 90-degree scan: 35 two-branch 90-degree nodes on the board, every one at a same-net pad or via whose copper covers the bend's inner corner; none in open copper.

Every new segment (R13 strap, R164 strap, 3V3A trunk, C11.2 / C10.2 returns, PYRO1_OUT's last vertical, PYRO1_CONT_MID) is octilinear with 45-degree bends only; the R13 and R164 straps are the octilinear-shortest paths to their via spots (1.228 / 1.638 mm).

C10.2's return leaves its pad 0.05 mm north of the pad centre, inside the 1.41 x 1.35 mm land (below route_check's 0.1 mm pad_end_offcentre threshold); recorded in AVA_LAYOUT and R10_VALIDATION. Not a rule instance.

PYRO1_CONT_MID 10.575 / 6.813 mm (1.55x, +3.76 mm) is below the 1.6x detour gate; its diagonal (16.87,60.82)-(17.85,61.8) is limited by Q123.1 at 0.2005 mm and its vertical by BUZZ_G's x 17.75 run, so no 45-degree start is earlier; the u_turn is information only (D-R18-05 corridor).
PYRO1_OUT's final vertical (16.87,57.97)-(16.87,58.62) is forced: a single diagonal ending on R173.1 would pass 0.07 mm from Q124's source via (15.85,57.695).

Independent GND-partner scan: 25 return-required critical layer-change vias (GND partner 0.770-1.492 mm, PYRO1_GATE (14.4,53.3) the largest) plus the plated pins J440.3 / J440.4 (1.500 mm each); every other critical layer change without a partner is on AUD-2's slow list (ACT_GATE x4, BAT_ENABLE x3, BAT_SW_SOURCE, BAT_SW_RETURN at J400.2, PYRO1_CONT, CAM_PWR_EN, CAM_UART_OE). No critical signal net has inner-layer tracks (In2 carries only USB_LIMITED and 3V3A).

The J440 GND vias (7.4,16.5) / (7.4,20.0) lie in the F.Cu and B.Cu GND fills and In1 GND; the 4-position terminal's pins 3 / 4 report UnconnectedLayerMode 3 and flash no In1 / In2 copper on J410, J420, J440 and J9 (pins 1 / 2 keep their rings).

In2 reference sampling under PYRO1_OUT, PYRO1_GATE and the AUX B.Cu runs: one In2 region each (GND for the pyro nets, 3V3 for AUX); the only void samples are the pins' / vias' own voids (AUX 24 of 52 samples inside the J440 pin void, as on 92c3ad59).

Near-node scan: the only near-coincident same-net nodes are the BUZZ_G T 0.02 mm before its chamfer (round 24 triage observation), VBUS / RAW_PROTECTED 0.05 mm Ts and C127.1's 0.0707 mm PYRO1_CONT piece inside its pad; identical on 92c3ad59.
Two-pad under-body via scan unchanged from 92c3ad59: five 0603 (R86, R89, R91, R101, R401), five 1210 (C400, C405, C411, C421, C461) and D8 (16.05,75.0) (round 26 observation).

Detour table (R10_VALIDATION section 6) reproduces exactly: 116 non-pour nets, 1500.8 / 1236.6 mm (1.214x), 23 nets at +3.5 mm or more; PYRO1_OUT 23.00 / 15.45, PYRO1_CONT_MID 10.57 / 6.81, 3V3A 36.56 / 33.97. ACT_FET_S and RADIO_TX_MCU (+3.07 mm each) also lie between +3.0 and +3.5 mm besides the two nets the text names below the line; the text does not claim that list is complete.
